summary: Split out of MPI-567. Four flow-frame bugs Fabio found on the first live look at Scribble to Object, all in code EVERY flow shares: inputs never persisted outside _run, spacebar advancing a step via native button activation on the focused nav arrow, no arrow-key navigation, and MpiColorPicker emitting a bare ui:close-all-popups that takes the whole Flow overlay down. Root causes traced to the line in plan.md - do not re-derive. Runs in PARALLEL with MPI-567, which owns the flow registries and the scribble workflow; this card owns MpiBaseFlow and MpiColorPicker.

Fifth bug folded in from MPI-567: promptRequired is declared on fifteen-odd ops in commandRegistry.js, its JSDoc calls a prompt mandatory, and NOTHING in js/ reads it. That is why an empty-prompt run of Scribble to Object was never stopped - the frame guard at MpiBaseFlow ~2029 aborts only when there is neither media nor a prompt, so a photo with no words runs. Same dead-declaration family as inputSchema.positive, which sat inert in the scribble FlowDef and read as a wired prompt to a whole session. The fix is frame code, so it was handed here rather than reached across the claim boundary.

Sixth item added from MPI-567, non-blocking but same file: a field id declared on a GIZMO step AND on the run slide silently drops edits from the second run onward. Gizmo steps key fields by role in _stepValues[role].fields while flow fields live in _fieldValues, and _collectInputs applies the flow store last; after one run the flow-level copy seeds from s_flowInputs at the payload root and overwrites what the user typed on the step. A kind:fields step does NOT have this problem because it is a FRAME kind with no role and seeds into the flow store by design, which is why character-sheet declaring its prompt twice works and reads as precedent. Either unify the stores for a shared id or make the collision loud. MPI-567 wants its prompt on both surfaces and cannot have it until this lands.

todo -> doing. Picked up the flow-frame card: six shared-frame bugs (input persistence, spacebar stage jump, arrow-key nav, colour picker closing the overlay, promptRequired inert, gizmo/flow field-store collision). files.json written with the frame footprint; MPI-567 keeps its claim on flowsRegistry/commandRegistry/operationRegistry and the scribble workflow copies.

All six frame bugs implemented and mutation-checked. 700 tests pass (686 + 14 new in tests/flow-frame.test.cjs); eight mutants, one per fix, all turned that file RED, with originals restored in a finally and verified byte-for-byte by sha256. Five of the six were then driven in a REAL app on an isolated instance (port 49998, own profile; the user's :3000 answered 200 before and after, and the tree was killed by the launcher PID I started): a typed prompt and a real PNG drop both survived close-and-reopen with NO run, on two different flows, with the image back in ITS OWN slot rather than packed to the first; a real click left focus on the arrow and a trusted Space then moved nothing while Enter still advanced; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft stepped 0-1-0; a colour picker opened inside the live flow overlay left the flow mounted while a BARE close-all pulse fired straight after destroyed it, which is the control that proves the reason payload is what saved it; and Generate on character-sheet with an empty prompt warned and left the queue at 0. Bug 6 has no live surface to click - no flow declares a shared id today, because MPI-567 reverted the one that did, which is precisely what this unblocks. SCOPE CHOSEN AND STATED: promptRequired is honoured in the flow frame only; enqueueGeneration was rejected because it would start refusing i2i/inpaint/edit/promptEnhance runs that ship today, so the flag stays inert on the eleven non-flow ops and that residual is open. Card stays in doing/validating: verify mode is user-ux and two of Fabio's five checks need a photo on the paint step and the History tool-option panels. No file claimed by MPI-567 was edited.

Second pass on Fabio live findings. (1) The picker rendered UNDERNEATH the overlay - fixing the close did not make it usable. It portals to document.body so z-index is the only thing keeping it above an overlay, and it was 9999, ONE below overlayManager BASE_Z 10000. Moved to the established 11000 portal layer MpiDropdown/MpiTreePicker/MpiStylePicker already use, written as .mpi-popup.mpi-color-picker__popup because the popup carries both classes and .mpi-popup is also 9999, so a single-class rule only ties and load order would decide. That exposed a second: measured bottom 1033 in a 1000px viewport, HEX field off screen, because positionPopup only corrected HORIZONTAL overflow - it now flips above the trigger and clamps. (2) Arrow keys died on the last step, caused by my own guard: _stepKey yielded on _videoBar || _compareView, but _compareView is non-null for an IMAGE compare too since MpiCompareView only binds when a side is VIDEO, so a replayed image result (MPI-587) mounted a view that binds nothing and ArrowLeft went dead on the Generate slide. Guard DELETED not narrowed - result surfaces are run-slide only, ArrowRight is already a nav no-op there so a video keeps forward frame-stepping, and ArrowLeft going back is what was asked for. Two tests pin it. 702 pass. Re-verified live in both exact reported states, plus a real click into the prompt field where two ArrowLefts moved the caret 7 to 5 with the step unchanged. Remaining check is unchanged: the five history tool-option panels, which now carry the z-index change too.

doing -> done. All six flow-frame bugs shipped across c4dacc0c and 949e9367, and Fabio confirmed in the app: 'everything works fine now'. That is the human verification the card was held in validating for (verify mode user-ux). Claim auditor ran over both commits: 24 claims proven, 2 flagged, both re-verified and both real. (1) OVERSTATED - the commit body and the card's own plan text say s_flowInputs had exactly ONE write site in the whole codebase; flowService.js:163 is a second one, seeding the key from a saved history item on the Reuse path. Diagnosis and fix unaffected (that seed only ever restores an already-run card, which is why nothing typed before a first Generate survived), but the wording was wrong and is corrected in validation.md; the test's single-writer assertion was always scoped to MpiBaseFlow.js and now says so. (2) UNPROVEN - the absolute test counts. They were real runner output when recorded but they move: 686 -> 700 -> 702 -> 703 across the session, the last change not mine, because MPI-567 is editing the same tree in parallel. The stable fact is the delta: tests/flow-frame.test.cjs is 16 tests, 16 pass, all added here. Board validator exits 1 on 21 pre-existing violations, every one of them MPI-573's malformed events plus its file-claim schema - none MPI-606's, and not mine to rewrite while that card is live in another session.
